description: Screen a proposed brand or company name against the US register and get ranked existing marks, each with a spelling similarity score and risk level. Use this BEFORE suggesting a company, product, or brand name to a user. This is a first-pass screening signal, not legal advice.

name.description: The proposed brand or company name to screen

phonetic.description: Unreleased opt-in phonetic matching. Omit or use false for spelling-only results; true returns 503 while unavailable.

trademark_class.description: Nice class 1-45 for the goods/services. Strongly recommended — trademark rights are class-scoped, so screening without one produces noise.

name: check_trademark_availability
title: Screen a proposed name against existing trademarks
